title: we made a free infinite crafting card game where the AI invents each card only once, and whoever finds it first keeps their name on it
author: OmnicrafterTeam
selftext:
hey, we're the team behind Omnicrafter, so just being upfront about that. it's a free infinite crafting card game in the browser, and the AI part is basically the whole design.

you drag two cards together. if nobody has tried that pair before, an AI invents the card (a name and 32x32 pixel art) and your name stays on it as mint #1. later copies get serial numbers. we generate each card once and cache it forever, so everyone sees the same one.

we wanted the world to feel shared, and we wanted being first to mean something. the trade-off is that a weird or bad result is permanent too, since everyone downstream builds on it. curious if anyone here has dealt with that: do you let people reroll, curate after the fact, or just let the weirdness stay

there's Solo Lab, a 1v1 Duel with a 4-letter room code, and a shared Infinite Canvas. free, phone or desktop, no download, no account needed: [https://omnicrafter.io/?src=reddit\_aigamedev&utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=social&utm\_campaign=aigamedev](https://omnicrafter.io/?src=reddit_aigamedev&utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=aigamedev)
